beats.narration_text: This is Liam, in for Bear. Every Walker film starts with a prompt — and this one is a reconstruction, not a transcript. The brief: take the Jumpman starter, double the level, and make it feel like Mario. Coins, question blocks, a patrolling grumbler, an Easter egg — have fun with it. Here is the level that came back.

props.command: Please use Walker to convert my game design document about a Mario-inspired platformer into a playable Godot project: double the level, add coins, question blocks, a patrolling enemy, and hide an Easter egg. Make it feel like Mario.
output: Level doubled: 960 → 1920 px, tutorial yard kept.

beats.narration_text: I doubled the First Steps level — 960 to 1920 pixels — keeping the original tutorial yard as it was. The new second half is the Mario stretch: green pipes, a staircase to a high platform, three question blocks that pay out coins from below, twenty-three coins in arcs and risky spots, a patrolling grumbler guarding the high platform, a sixty-four-pixel spike bed at the finish, and one invisible block hiding five bonus coins. One correction: a scripted driver beats this with zero deaths — but no human has played it. Beatable in code isn't proven in feel.

beats.narration_text: The mechanics the full run skipped. Pause freezes the game — ENTER resumes where you left off. The hidden block: jumped the exact spot, found nothing. The climb needs eighty-four pixels; the jump tops out at fifty-three. And the grumbler — land on it falling, and it squashes flat.

shot.note: PROVISIONAL narration; finalize against actual take outcomes.

beats.narration_text: More ways to fail. Walk into the grumbler’s side — squashed; no stomp without the fall. Run off the gap — missed the landing. R restarts instantly; M from pause drops back to the menu.

shot.note: Pre-trimmed media/B06B.mp4 from take_sidekill_4k + take_fallretry_4k; narration window conforms to the action, no retiming.

beats.narration_text: Verdict. Observed working: the full route completes — menus, movement, bonks, coins, pipes, stairs, the grumbler patrol, spike deaths, auto-retry, and the completion ranking. Defects: the hidden Easter-egg block is real but unreachable by normal play. The Coin master rank can never fire — a dead branch in the code. And no human has playtested this; every run you saw was scripted input. Planned, not built: moving platforms, checkpoints, more levels.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Open Walker and add a moving platform to the gap after the pipes — ride it across without falling. Or hide your own Easter egg. Somewhere mean.
